C0822.title: Australian Taxation Office Investigates 150 Employees Over Suspected GST Fraud
C0822.summary: In February 2024, the Australian Taxation Office was reported to be investigating 150 internal employees suspected of involvement in GST fraud. The GST fraud was related to Operation Protego and triggered scrutiny over whether insiders participated in or assisted the fraud. The incident highlights the importance of insider compliance, privilege use, and anti-fraud monitoring in large tax and public service systems.
